splicing.score: mean signed ALT-minus-REF canonical acceptor and donor probability
splicing.alternate_coordinates: unaligned; map complete allele, zero at deleted sites

mpra.source_setting: Enformer settings DNASE cell type matching
departures: Use AlphaGenome's published recommended 501-bp log2((sum ALT + 1)/(sum REF + 1)) scorer with the published Enformer-setting track matches; the API does not expose the historical 512-bp DIFF_SUM mask.
Use source-validated GRCh38 alleles rather than the paper's hg19 inputs.
GP1BA is the source filename for GP1BB; MYCrs6983267 maps to MYC.
TCF7L2 and ZRSh13 have no published match in this table and are excluded.
Use the current ALL_FOLDS API model; historical server weights are not version-addressable.
Extend the published scoring recipe to complete indels using API score_variant alignment.

known_overlap.mpra: CAGI5 MPRA was evaluated in the original AlphaGenome paper; the benchmark is public development data.
known_overlap.splicing: OpenSplice evaluated AlphaGenome and selected 16-kb context using that dataset; this context choice is not held out.
known_overlap.avi: BRCA1, RAD51C and DDX3X source studies were used for AVI model selection. Other unknown overlap remains unknown.
